page.description: Public keys this package's release signatures are verified against.

intro.optional: Signing is optional. Publishers sign their release files locally with `lode-cli sign`.
intro.publicOnly: Register the PUBLIC key here. The server never holds a private key; it only verifies signatures when a file is uploaded.
intro.ci: A pipeline can register its key itself: a token with a write grant on this package may add keys, but never revoke one.

empty: No signing keys for this package yet. Register a public key to have signed uploads verified.
copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

register.title: Register a signing key
register.description: Paste the public half of an ed25519 key pair. Never paste a private key.
register.name: Name
register.forms: Accepted: the bare base64 or base64url key, or one of the forms lode prints:

error.whitespace: The key must not contain spaces or line breaks. Paste it as a single line.
error.privateKey: This looks like a private key or a PEM block. Paste only the base64 public key, and keep the private key to yourself.

revoke.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revoke.description: Revocation is final. This key cannot be registered again, and new uploads stop verifying under it. Signatures already published stay in the manifest.
